title: Monday 23 - Tuesday 24 November
detail:
**Monday 23 November**

Due to an operational issue with the sector light at Ardrossan being inoperable, service is liable to disruption or cancellation at short notice.

An update regarding repairs will be provided on Monday 23 November.

Due to forecast easterly winds, service from the 13:55 departing Brodick is a heightened risk of diversion to Troon.

There will be a review at 13:15 for service for the remainder of the day.

**Tuesday 24 November**

Due to forecast easterly winds, the 07:00 departing Ardrossan is liable to operate from Troon.

title: Monday 23 - Tuesday 24 November
detail:
Due to an adverse weather forecast this evening into Tuesday morning, the 18:10 departing Troon is **cancelled**.

**Tuesday 24 November**

As a result of the cancellation of the 18:10 sailing from Troon on Monday, the 07:30 departing Brodick on Tuesday 24 November is cancelled.

Due to adverse weather, service is liable to disruption or cancellation at short notice.

title: Tuesday 24 November
detail:
Due to expected swell and forecast easterly winds, MV Caledonian Isles will operate via Troon to the following timetable:

**Depart** Troon 07:00

Arrive Brodick 08:20

**Depart** Brodick 09:10

Arrive Troon 10:30

**Depart** Troon 11:30

Arrive Brodick 12:50

Service remains liable to disruption or cancellation at short notice.

A review will take place at approximately 11:00 to determine whether MV Caledonian Isles will continue operating via Troon or resume service to/from Ardrossan.

title: Monday 23 November
detail:
Service will continue to operate to/from Ardrossan until the 18:55 arrival in Brodick this evening.

Due to forecast easterly winds, upon arrival in Brodick the vessel will load and depart as soon as possible before diverting to Troon for overnight berthing:

**Depart** Brodick 19:00

Arrive Troon 20:20

Please note, vehicles may be required to turn or reverse on the car deck due to the diversion to Troon.

Due to an operational issue with the sector light at Ardrossan being inoperable, service is heightened risk of disruption or cancellation from the 16:40 departing Brodick.

title: Tuesday 24 November
detail:

Due to adverse weather, service is liable to disruption or cancellation at short notice.
